title: After Daeun's Support
description:
Two months since Daeun was there for you.
That support had stayed with you.
Today a message came from her.

choices.text: Tell her things are going well
choices.result_text:
You said things were going well.
She said 'Glad to hear it.'

You asked how she was first.
She paused a moment before answering.

title: Until the Guard Came Down
description:
Two months since Daeun kept her distance.
She'd crossed your path a few times in between.
Today she spoke to you first.

choices.result_text:
You let the conversation flow.
Time had lowered the guard.

choices.text: Ask why all of a sudden
choices.result_text:
You said 'Why all of a sudden?'
She smiled and said 'Just because.'

title: After Being Understood
description:
Two months since Daeun understood.
That feeling had lingered.
Today — for the first time — she brought up something of her own.

choices.result_text:
You listened.
She said 'I only tell you this.'

You thought it through with her.
She said 'I didn't think we could do this kind of thing together.'

title: After Letting Her Pass
description:
Two months since you let Daeun pass.
She still crossed your path now and then.
Today you crossed again.

choices.result_text:
You said hello first.
She looked briefly surprised.

You let her go again.
She passed too.

title: The Job from a Returned Wallet
description:
Two months into the job that came from returning the wallet.
It had been an unfamiliar start.
Today — you felt yourself settling in.

choices.result_text:
You'd found it.
A chance connection had led to work.

choices.text: Still a little out of place
choices.result_text:
Still a little out of place.
But you'd started.

title: After Turning Down the Reward
description:
Two months since you returned the wallet and turned down the offer.
That choice came back to you sometimes.
Today the person reached out.

choices.result_text:
You picked up warmly.
They still remembered.

You asked why they were calling.
'Just wanted to see how you were doing,' they said.

title: After Backing Down
description:
Two months since you backed down from the credit dispute.
It had felt unfair, but you let it go.
Today you heard how it turned out.

choices.result_text:
The other party admitted the problem first.
Because you hadn't fought, there was no conflict — and that made a settlement possible.

Still felt unfair.
But the result wasn't bad.

title: After Going Over Their Head
description:
Two months since you went above your direct contact.
The aftermath had been awkward.
Today things were resolved.

choices.result_text:
It was resolved.
Going to a higher level had made the difference.

The outcome was right but the relationship felt strained.
It was still the right move.

title: After Letting Go of the Coin
description:
Two months since you closed the crypto position.
Regret had stayed with you.
Today you looked at the chart again.

choices.result_text:
It had gone up further — then dropped by half.
Selling when you did wasn't bad.

Still wished you'd held.
That's just what investing is.

title: After Pushing Through the Dinner
description:
A month since you stayed through a work dinner you hated.
You thought nothing would change.
Today the team lead called you aside.

choices.result_text:
'I've noticed you putting in the effort lately,' they said.
Staying through that dinner — had been seen.

choices.text: It turned out to be nothing much
choices.result_text:
It wasn't much.
But being called at all was something.

title: After Taking the Half Day
description:
A month since you slipped out early from the work dinner.
You'd been conscious of what the others thought.
Today one of those colleagues said something.

choices.result_text: 'Honestly, I wanted to do that too,' they said.

You said 'What's wrong with that?'
They laughed.

title: After Dodging the Dinner
description:
A month since you made an excuse and skipped the work dinner.
You'd been watching the team dynamics since.
Today you looked back on it.

choices.text: Think it was fine to skip
choices.result_text:
Nothing in particular had changed.
Skipping it — had passed without any real cost.

The lingering awkwardness in the team was on your mind.
You decided to stay next time.

title: After Moving Up a Level
description:
Three months since you moved up socially.
That position was starting to feel normal.
Today — someone you couldn't have reached before reached out first.

choices.result_text:
You met.
This was only possible because you'd moved up.

choices.text: Figure out why they're contacting you first
choices.result_text:
You looked into it first.
It was a harmless connection.

title: After Being Recognized as Elite
description:
Three months since that circle acknowledged you.
Your name had started to travel.
Today — an unexpected opportunity came in.

choices.result_text:
You looked into it.
The recognition had built this opportunity.

choices.text: Decide it's not the right time yet
choices.result_text:
You said not yet.
They said 'Understood — reach out when you're ready.'

title: After the Reconciliation Began
description:
Two months since the careful beginning of reconciliation with your father.
At first it had been awkward.
Today a text came from him.

choices.result_text:
You replied immediately.
A short text — but different from before.

choices.text: Think carefully about what to say
choices.result_text:
You sat with what to write for a while.
You sent 'Yeah. Me too.'
